5.Method of Recriutment:
For Each Category Merit list will be prepared based on the marks obtained in Written Exam
and/or interview Conducted and displayed on Jangaon District website for transparency.
6. Nature of Duties and Responsibilities :
1. Art Teacher: Teaching drawing, painting, sketching and other visual arts, encouraging
creativity and preparing students for art competitions and exhibitions.
2. Yoga Teacher: Conducting yoga classes, teaching asanas. pranayama and meditation, and
promoting physical and mental well-being among students.
3. Computer Teacher: Teaching computer education, conducting practical and theory classes,
maintaining computer laboratories and promoting digital literacy.
4. Librarian: Maintaining library books and records, cataloguing and classification of books,
assisting students and staff in accessing library resources and managing library activities.
7. Terms and Conditions :
1. The engagement shall be purely on an outsourcing basis and shall not confer any right for
regular appointment or permanent absorption in Government service.
2. The period of engagement shall be from 09.I1.2026 to 31.03.2027 or until the actual
requirement ceases to exist, whichever is earlier.
3. The candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualifications and satisfy the prescribed
age limits and eligibility conditions.
4. The remuneration shall be paid as prescribed by the Government, subject to applicable rules
and instructions.
5. The engagement shall be made through the existing outsourcing agency/new outsourcing
agency, as appropriate.
6. All relevant original certificates relating to educational qualifications, age and other eligibility
conditions shall be verified before engagement.
7. The selected personnel shall work under the administrative control of the concerned
Telangana Model School Headmaster/Principal and shall discharge the duties assigned to
them.
8. The District Collector, Jangaon, reserves the right to cancel or modify the notification in
accordance with Government instructions and administrative requirements.
